```yaml
name: Bump openinference-instrumentation dependency

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --upgrade pip

      - name: Bump dependency
        id: bump
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          BRANCH="bump-openinference-instrumentation-${NEW_VERSION}"
          echo "New version: $NEW_VERSION"
          echo "Branch: $BRANCH"

          # Find all files containing the dependency
          FILES=$(git grep -l 'openinference-instrumentation' -- '*')
          if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then
            echo "No files found with openinference-instrumentation dependency."
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # Create new branch
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

          # Update dependency lines
          for FILE in $FILES; do
            echo "Updating $FILE"
            sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation[^\n]*=).*/\\1 \">=${NEW_VERSION}\"/" "$FILE"
          done

          # Check if there are changes
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected."
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # Commit changes
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add $FILES
          git commit -m "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${NEW_VERSION}"
          git push --set-upstream origin "$BRANCH"

          echo "branch=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.bump.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const branch = '${{ steps.bump.outputs.branch }}';
            const title = `chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}`;
            const body = `This PR updates the minimum version of \`openinference-instrumentation\` to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }} across all instrumentor packages.`;
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title,
              body,
              head: branch,
              base: 'main',
              draft: false
            });
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.number}`);
```
